comparison.objective: Clamp a marked bar and drill through it safely; candidate transfers an uncaged LM block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests workpiece restraint, screw-clamp tightening, drill-feed operation, and hazard clearance. Candidate tests precision rail–jig alignment and controlled bearing-block sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a correctly located through-hole, adequate clamp force, retracted drill, and no unsafe hand proximity or loose-bar event. Candidate requires complete ball-preserving transfer without seam separation or inclination.
comparison.reason: Machining setup and guarded drilling test different physical abilities and outcomes.
